summary: Town of Vulcan camping page (read 2026-11-11): free first 3 consecutive nights in six months, C$20 a night from the 4th, 14-night max, no reservations, water and sewage disposal - all as stored (manual, 2026-11-10). Phone 403-485-2417 and pin confirmed. Nothing new.
